summary: V30 Subscription Renewal Reminder — fully green. Backend: 12/12 pytest passing (test_v30_renewal.py). GET /api/plugin/renewal-info returns proper payload with all fields (licensed, days_left, expires_at, should_show_banner, severity, plan, customer_name, license_key, renewal_url). Severity thresholds verified: 365d→null/no-banner, 31d→info, 10d→warning, 3d→critical. POST /api/subscription/renew works for both yearly and monthly, returns Stripe checkout url+session_id with renewal:true, current_plan, current_expires. Cron _license_expiry_alerts_task correctly uses valid_until with 30/14/3 day thresholds (server.py line 707+, 730, 739). No startup crash, task registered at line 464. Frontend: RenewalBanner renders on /panel with correct data-testid, data-severity attribute, tone colors (warning=orange, critical=rose w/ animate-pulse). CTA data-testid=renewal-banner-cta links to /panel/subscription?renew=1. Dismiss button hidden for critical severity. Banner hidden on /panel/subscription route. Subscription page reads ?renew=1 → shows 'Tek Tık 1 Yıl Uzat' button (data-testid=sub-quick-renew) in HERO card. Regression: plugin/status has license_version, engines/spam/toggle 200, broadcast-refresh guards master properly, admin endpoints and analytics endpoint respond without 500. License restored to 365d post-test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at ~5172 lines — still growing; split into routers (renewal.py, plugin_status.py, subscription.py) is overdue.

/api/plugin/renewal-info is called every 5 minutes by every panel client and executes _plugin_status_payload() which itself performs several DB reads. Consider caching plugin_status_payload for ~30s to reduce Mongo load under many concurrent panels.

subscription_renew stores 'renewal_intent:<key>' in settings but there is no visible consumer in webhook success flow to actually extend valid_until — verify checkout_success handler reads this key, otherwise renewal will just create a new license row instead of extending.

RenewalBanner sessionStorage key gws.renewal_banner_dismissed is not scoped per-license — after license switch on the same browser, previous dismissal state carries over. Consider suffixing with license_key.
renewal-info fallback (invalid ISO date) returns should_show_banner=false silently — should log warning for debuggability.
